Read all files from other documents
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(gt)
library(scales)

fix_bad_years <- function(x) {
  x <- as.Date(x)
  if_else(year(x) < 100, x %m+% years(2000), x)
}

# Load data
pl <- readRDS("pl_match_test_eval.rds")
ll <- readRDS("ll_match_test_eval.rds")
sa <- readRDS("sa_match_test_eval.rds")
bl <- readRDS("bl_match_test_eval.rds")

pooled <- bind_rows(
  pl %>% mutate(league = "PL"),
  ll %>% mutate(league = "LL"),
  sa %>% mutate(league = "SA"),
  bl %>% mutate(league = "BL")
)
```

MAIN PAPER OUTPUTS

Data overview table
```{r}
data_overview_table <- bind_rows(
  readRDS("pl_clean.rds") %>% mutate(league = "PL"),
  readRDS("ll_clean.rds") %>% mutate(league = "LL"),
  readRDS("sa_clean.rds") %>% mutate(league = "SA"),
  readRDS("bl_clean.rds") %>% mutate(league = "BL")
) %>%
  mutate(Date = fix_bad_years(Date)) %>%
  group_by(league) %>%
  summarise(
    bookmaker_matches = n(),
    first_date = min(Date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_date = max(Date, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    bind_rows(
      readRDS("pl_team_match_df.rds") %>% mutate(league = "PL"),
      readRDS("ll_team_match_df.rds") %>% mutate(league = "LL"),
      readRDS("sa_team_match_df.rds") %>% mutate(league = "SA"),
      readRDS("bl_team_match_df.rds") %>% mutate(league = "BL")
    ) %>%
      group_by(league) %>%
      summarise(team_match_rows = n(), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "league"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    pooled %>%
      group_by(league) %>%
      summarise(test_matches = n(), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "league"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    bets_main_pooled %>%
      group_by(league) %>%
      summarise(main_strategy_bets = n(), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "league"
  )

data_overview_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Data overview by league") %>%
  cols_label(
    league = "League",
    bookmaker_matches = "Bookmaker matches",
    first_date = "First date",
    last_date = "Last date",
    team_match_rows = "Team-match rows",
    test_matches = "Test matches",
    main_strategy_bets = "Main strategy bets"
  ) %>%
  fmt_date(columns = c(first_date, last_date), date_style = "iso") %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 13,
    data_row.padding = px(4)
  )
```
Pooled forecast performance
```{r}
forecast_performance_table <- results_pooled %>%
  mutate(
    log_loss = round(log_loss, 4),
    brier = round(brier, 4)
  )

forecast_performance_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Pooled forecast performance",
    subtitle = "Comparison of model forecast accuracy across all leagues"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    model = "Model",
    log_loss = "Log loss",
    brier = "Brier score"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(log_loss, brier),
    decimals = 4
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 13,
    data_row.padding = px(4),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  )
```
Diebold-Mariano test
```{r}
library(forecast)

dm_nb <- dm.test(
  e1 = (pooled$home_win.y - pooled$p_home_nb)^2,
  e2 = (pooled$home_win.y - pooled$fair_home)^2,
  h = 1,
  power = 2
)

dm_xgb <- dm.test(
  e1 = (pooled$home_win.y - pooled$p_home_xgb)^2,
  e2 = (pooled$home_win.y - pooled$fair_home)^2,
  h = 1,
  power = 2
)

dm_table <- tibble(
  comparison = c("NB model vs Bookmaker", "XGBoost model vs Bookmaker"),
  dm_statistic = c(as.numeric(dm_nb$statistic), as.numeric(dm_xgb$statistic)),
  p_value = c(dm_nb$p.value, dm_xgb$p.value)
) %>%
  mutate(
    dm_statistic = round(dm_statistic, 3),
    p_value = signif(p_value, 3)
  )

dm_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Diebold-Mariano test",
    subtitle = "Forecast accuracy compared with bookmaker probabilities"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    comparison = "Comparison",
    dm_statistic = "DM statistic",
    p_value = "p-value"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = dm_statistic,
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = p_value,
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 13,
    data_row.padding = px(4),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  )
```
Main betting strategy with bootstrap CI
```{r}
main_strategy_table <- tibble(
  strategy = "Mid-range odds + high expected goal intensity",
  avg_profit = mean(bets_main_pooled$profit, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_bets = nrow(bets_main_pooled),
  ci_lower = quantile(boot_means_pooled, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
  ci_median = quantile(boot_means_pooled, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
  ci_upper = quantile(boot_means_pooled, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
) %>%
  mutate(
    avg_profit = round(avg_profit, 4),
    ci_lower = round(ci_lower, 4),
    ci_median = round(ci_median, 4),
    ci_upper = round(ci_upper, 4)
  )

main_strategy_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Main betting strategy",
    subtitle = "Average profit with bootstrap confidence interval"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    strategy = "Strategy",
    avg_profit = "Average profit",
    n_bets = "Number of bets",
    ci_lower = "CI lower",
    ci_median = "CI median",
    ci_upper = "CI upper"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(avg_profit, ci_lower, ci_median, ci_upper),
    decimals = 4
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 13,
    data_row.padding = px(4),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  )
```
